# =============================================================================
#  redaction-corpus.txt - what a captured log must never carry, and must keep
# =============================================================================
# The corpus exists because redaction is about to have a SECOND implementation.
# `cap_redact` is a stack of sed expressions; a PowerShell station will have a
# stack of regexes, and the two will drift the moment one of them gains a rule
# the other does not. Neither is the specification. This file is.
#
# It is read by conformance property 7, which emits every line through the
# implementation's own capture path and then asserts on the log. That is a
# weaker test than a unit test of the redactor and deliberately so: what it
# proves is that the redactor is actually WIRED IN. A correct redactor a second
# implementation forgets to call is exactly the drift this suite exists for,
# and no unit test can see it.
#
# BOTH DIRECTIONS ARE ASSERTED. These logs are the only evidence anybody gets
# from a machine they cannot reach, and a redactor that eats ordinary output is
# its own failure - one that costs a round trip through an operator to
# discover. So every KEEP line here is a line a real log needs.
#
# FORMAT - three TAB-separated fields:
#
#   MASK<TAB><the exact string that must NOT survive><TAB><the line to emit>
#   KEEP<TAB><the exact string that MUST survive><TAB><the line to emit>
#
# Tab, because a credential contains every other punctuation character there
# is. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
#
# Every secret below is fictional and shaped like the real thing, because the
# shape is what the rule matches on. Do not shorten them: several rules have a
# minimum length precisely so that `Bearer yes` is not mistaken for a token.
# =============================================================================

# --- key=value, the form most steps print by accident ------------------------
MASK	hunter2correct	password=hunter2correct
MASK	s3cr3t-value-here	PASSWORD: "s3cr3t-value-here"
MASK	abc123def456ghi	api_key = abc123def456ghi
MASK	zzz-client-secret-zzz	client_secret='zzz-client-secret-zzz'
MASK	AccountKeyValue123456	AccountKey=AccountKeyValue123456;EndpointSuffix=core.windows.net
MASK	sp=racwd-sas-token	connectionstring=sp=racwd-sas-token

# --- credentials inside a URL ------------------------------------------------
# Two rules cover these. The first needs a colon; the second catches the bare
# `https://<token>@host` form, which is the commonest GitHub PAT clone URL
# there is and would otherwise print in full.
MASK	glpat-LEAKEDTOKENVALUE	cloning https://ci-user:glpat-LEAKEDTOKENVALUE@git.invalid/x.git
MASK	ghp_0123456789abcdefghij	remote: https://ghp_0123456789abcdefghij@github.com/org/repo.git
# A userinfo that is NOT a recognisable vendor token and carries no colon. Every
# other bare-userinfo line here happened to start `ghp_`, so the GitHub rule
# caught them and this one - the rule that exists for exactly this shape - could
# be deleted unnoticed. Found by deleting it.
MASK	OPAQUEUSERINFOTOKEN12345	fetching https://OPAQUEUSERINFOTOKEN12345@git.invalid/x.git
MASK	appuserpassword	postgres://appuser:appuserpassword@db.invalid:5432/app

# --- headers -----------------------------------------------------------------
MASK	eyJleUJTRUNSRVQiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9	Authorization: Bearer eyJleUJTRUNSRVQiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9
MASK	dXNlcjpwYXNzd29yZDEyMzQ1Ng==	Authorization: Basic dXNlcjpwYXNzd29yZDEyMzQ1Ng==
# AND WITHOUT THE `Authorization:` PREFIX, which is not a duplicate of the two
# above. There is a rule for the header and separate rules for the two schemes,
# and while every Bearer in the corpus sat behind an `Authorization:` the
# header rule caught them all - so both scheme rules could be deleted and this
# file reported a clean run. Found by deleting them. A token turns up in a
# curl trace and a config dump as often as in a header.
MASK	AbCdEf0123456789ghijklmnopqrs	retrying with Bearer AbCdEf0123456789ghijklmnopqrs
MASK	dXNlcm5hbWU6c2VjcmV0cGFzc3dk	proxy credential Basic dXNlcm5hbWU6c2VjcmV0cGFzc3dk
# A SCHEME THAT IS NEITHER Bearer NOR Basic. The generic `Authorization:` rule
# is what covers the schemes nobody enumerated - and while every header here
# used one of the two named schemes, that rule could be deleted with nothing
# noticing. Found by deleting it.
MASK	abcdefghijklmnopqrstuv	Authorization: Token abcdefghijklmnopqrstuv

# --- vendor-shaped tokens, recognised by their own prefix --------------------
# EVERY ONE OF THESE APPEARS BARE, outside a URL and outside a key=value, and
# that is the whole point of the section. The first draft had `glpat-` only
# inside a clone URL, where the URL rule catches it - so the GitLab rule could
# be deleted outright and this corpus reported a clean run. Found by deleting
# it. A rule that is only ever exercised through another rule is not tested.
MASK	glpat-BARETOKENNOTINAURL1	leaked glpat-BARETOKENNOTINAURL1 to the log
MASK	ghp_aaaabbbbccccddddeeee	found ghp_aaaabbbbccccddddeeee in the environment
MASK	github_pat_11ABCDEFG0abcdefghijkl	github_pat_11ABCDEFG0abcdefghijkl was exported
MASK	AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE	aws_access_key_id AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
MASK	xoxb-1234567890-abcdefghij	slack webhook xoxb-1234567890-abcdefghij failed
MASK	sk-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012345	openai key sk-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012345 rejected
MASK	eyJhbGciOi.eyJzdWIiOi.SflKxwRJSM	the jwt eyJhbGciOi.eyJzdWIiOi.SflKxwRJSM expired

# --- a private key's opening line --------------------------------------------
# Only the BEGIN line is matched, which is honest: the body is base64 and
# indistinguishable from ordinary output. Catching the header is what stops a
# `cat id_rsa` from being unmistakably a key in a committed log.
MASK	-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----	-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----

# --- what must SURVIVE, because it is the evidence ---------------------------
# Every one of these has been mistaken for a secret by an over-eager redactor
# at some point, and each is something a reader actually needs.
KEEP	listening on port 8443 and exit code 0	listening on port 8443 and exit code 0
KEEP	token bucket refill rate is 5/s	token bucket refill rate is 5/s
KEEP	no password set for this account	no password set for this account
KEEP	https://docs.invalid/guide/authentication	see https://docs.invalid/guide/authentication
KEEP	Bearer	Authorization: Bearer short
KEEP	sha256:9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08	image digest sha256:9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08
KEEP	user=deploybot	connected as user=deploybot
KEEP	ERROR: disk /dev/sda1 is 98% full	ERROR: disk /dev/sda1 is 98% full
